task_objective: Merge the completed and reviewed fuzzy SQL IntelliSense feature from dev into main and publish minor release v0.11.0.
design_decisions: Use v0.11.0 because main and the latest published release are at v0.10.3 and the requested release type is minor.
Promote the reviewed dev branch containing fuzzy catalog matching, in-scope SQL aliases, DuckDB functions, and Spark built-in function discovery.
Build the GitHub release title and notes from CHANGELOG.md before tagging, as required by the release workflow.
Increment README image cacheBuster values from 35 to 36 for the new release tag.
Use scripts/orchestration-hooks/finalize-release minor on main for the version bump, release commit, annotated tag, and push.
known_limitations: Spark's comprehensive built-in function catalog is discovered asynchronously only after the Spark execution engine is selected and initialized; curated Spark functions remain available before then.

results.feature_verification: Fuzzy matching, aliases, DuckDB functions, and live Spark built-in discovery passed their focused and integration tests before release preparation.
results.quality_gates: Ruff check, Ruff format, ty, and the full default test suite passed on dev: 872 passed, 9 deselected, 91% coverage. The gate is rerun on main before tagging.
results.release_automation: The tag-triggered release workflow, GitHub release assets, and fresh PyPI installation are verified after v0.11.0 is pushed.
